questions.title: Resolve ADSL screen-failure population descriptions
questions.excerpt: All patients in DM were included in ADSL.
questions.guidance: The ADRG says all DM patients are included, while adam-pilot-5.xlsx, Datasets sheet row 5, states "one record per subject. Screen Failures are excluded." The ADSL specification filters DM.ACTARM <> 'Screen Failure'. Confirm the governing population and align the retained descriptions. Record selection is outside the current derivation-rule verifier, so this question awaits human review.

questions.title: Confirm the ADTTE duration predecessor name
questions.excerpt:
Label: Duration of treatment (days)
Data type: integer
questions.guidance: The original Define-XML ItemDef IT.ADTTE.TRTDUR, def:Origin Description (lines 1928-1937), names ADSL.TRTDUR. Published ADSL instead contains TRTDURD, which the specification reads. Confirm and correct the intended predecessor in a separate change. The current verifier omits child Origin descriptions, so its document-silent result cannot establish that the derivation is undocumented.

questions.title: Confirm the ADAE identifier predecessors
questions.excerpt:
Label: Unique Subject Identifier
Data type: text
questions.guidance: Original Define-XML IT.ADAE.STUDYID (lines 2059-2069) and IT.ADAE.USUBJID (lines 2077-2087) name ADSL.STUDYID and ADSL.USUBJID in child Origin descriptions. The executable specification instead reads AE.STUDYID and AE.USUBJID. Confirm the intended provenance and whether the key join makes these sources equivalent for the intended records. Child Origin text is omitted by the current verifier projection; the cited label is verified, while predecessor details require the original XML. No affected-record count is asserted.

questions.title: Resolve unavailable lab population predecessors
questions.excerpt:
Label: Completers of Week 24 Population Flag
Data type: text
questions.guidance: Original Define-XML child Origins name ADSL.COM01P24FL (IT.ADLBC.COMP24FL, lines 1518-1529), ADSL.DSR01AEFL (IT.ADLBC.DSRAEFL, lines 1530-1541) and ADSL.SAF01FL (IT.ADLBC.SAFFL, lines 1542-1553). None exists in the published ADSL schema; COMP24FL, DSRAEFL and SAFFL are present and used by executable derivations. Confirm the intended aliases and document version before correcting the predecessor names. The projected label is verified; the omitted predecessor text must be checked in original XML. No affected-record count is asserted.

questions.title: Resolve the unavailable lab parameter-code predecessor
questions.excerpt:
Label: Parameter Code
Data type: text
questions.guidance: Original Define-XML IT.ADLBC.PARAMCD child Origin, lines 1616-1627, names LB.TESTCD. The published LB schema contains LBTESTCD and has no TESTCD; executable parameter-code logic uses _r_LBTESTCD with source and derived-row rules. Confirm the intended predecessor and the rules for derived parameter codes. Child Origin text is omitted from the current projection; the cited label is verified and the predecessor requires original XML inspection. No affected-record count is asserted.

questions.title: Resolve unavailable time-to-event treatment predecessors

Label: Planned Treatment

questions.guidance: Original Define-XML child Origins name ADSL.TRTP (IT.ADTTE.TRTP, lines 1939-1949), ADSL.TRTA (IT.ADTTE.TRTA, lines 1950-1960) and ADSL.TRTAN (IT.ADTTE.TRTAN, lines 1961-1972). None exists in published ADSL; TRT01P, TRT01A and TRT01AN are present and used by executable ADTTE derivations. Confirm the intended period-specific predecessors and package version.
